resolutions.title: Every current atmosphere has a record
resolutions.choice: All 14 current image tokens have exact file identity, role, pairing and provenance-confidence fields. Eleven previously unrecorded assets remain honest about unknown creation history.
resolutions.remaining: Recover generator/date/rights evidence before unrestricted external exports.

resolutions.title: Missing references are explicit
resolutions.choice: Neither references/ nor assets/capability-illustrations/ exists in the preserved extraction or current tracked sibling tree. No replacement image is invented.
resolutions.remaining: Recover originals if needed; unavailable files are not build dependencies.

resolutions.title: One pairing table
resolutions.choice: The register includes Mulberry, Amber and Graphite. Mineral inverse is the primary document inspector; neutral inverse is a scoped agent-context exception.
resolutions.remaining: Founder review of the reconciled specimens; production adoption remains separate.

resolutions.title: Verification and closing recipes
resolutions.choice: Mulberry is the proposed current verification recipe, following the later component/census/checker. Dusk is the proposed closing default; Spectrum is reserved for a rare major opening/proof.
resolutions.remaining: Archive the conflicting recipe text only at adoption; original source stays immutable.

resolutions.title: Illustration is not evidence
resolutions.choice: A live constellation diagram can explain labelled relationships. The generic constellation/global-field rasters remain excluded. Evidence-stack stays an unapproved editorial reference.
resolutions.remaining: Missing capability illustrations are unavailable; no complete icon library is claimed.

resolutions.title: Identity and functional glyphs are separate
resolutions.choice: Keep the flowing-S lockup as the identity reference. The compass remains a legacy favicon conflict; a four-point transformation glyph has a functional role, not an identity role.
resolutions.remaining: Produce S favicon/avatar/inverse exports from a verified mark master and test small sizes in the identity batch.

rules.text: Choose a plain canvas, one atmospheric raster, or a bounded gradient frame. A dark raster already contains its lighting; never add a second semantic gradient.
In this specimen release, reading text sits on its named surface. No direct text-on-image combination is approved by this catalogue.
Decorative green is not success. Atmosphere conveys tone; labelled product states need real evidence.
Plain sections are part of the system. Use open, compact and framed compositions according to the narrative; do not alternate only by changing colours.
Amber has no card recipe. Dusk and Ember use neutral inverse only as a rare dominant contrast object; matched warm glass remains an open gap.

specimens.compact_rule: Square and narrow specimens remove the secondary row before changing typography. These are composition samples, not approved channel templates.

visual_review.finding: Core families remain coherent. Warm and graphite plates need restricted roles because available neutral inverse glass is visibly blue-biased. Narrow hero crops do not retain the desktop quiet-left field.
